root_cause_analysis.diagnostic_question: Why did V1 abort dispatch fan out to 96 run_finemap jobs but V2 dispatch fan out to 0?
root_cause_analysis.v1_pre_fire_state: results/qtl_coloc/ had 1,274 STALE JSONs (mtime older than run_susie_rss.R script at commit 02c4404); results/fine_mapping/susie/ had ~192 .fit.rds + .json files
root_cause_analysis.v2_pre_fire_state: results/qtl_coloc/ EMPTY (mv'd in Step 3); results/fine_mapping/susie/ EMPTY (mv'd in Step 3); ALL upstream outputs touched in Step 1 to mtime newer than scripts
root_cause_analysis.snakemake_dag_logic: all_qtl_coloc input chain: aggregate_qtl_coloc consumes a dynamic-glob over results/qtl_coloc/*.json. Empty glob => 0 inputs => skeleton summary => no per-region work scheduled. The 96 run_finemap fanout in V1 was triggered by the script-newer-than-outputs cascade through the SuSiE-RSS layer's mtime check, which then forced 1,274 run_qtl_coloc reruns. After Step 1's --touch, that cascade is neutered (script == outputs mtime relationship).
root_cause_analysis.why_run_finemap_did_not_fire_via_missing: DAG enumeration of run_finemap is driven by the all_qtl_coloc target's dependency chain. With NO per-region run_qtl_coloc jobs scheduled, NO run_finemap jobs are scheduled. The dependency only flows DOWN from per-region run_qtl_coloc, not UP from missing susie outputs alone.
